targets.rawSql: select count(*) filter (where email_verified_at is not null)::float / nullif(count(*), 0) as verified from users where role = 'user'

panels.title: Players with a running bot, of all players

targets.rawSql: select count(distinct a.owner_id) filter (where s.actual_state = 'running') as "with a running bot", (select count(*) from users where role = 'user') as "all players" from game_accounts a join users u on u.id = a.owner_id and u.role = 'user' left join bot_status s on s.account_id = a.id

panels.title: Signups per day
panels.description: From auth.signup audit rows, which outlive a deleted player. Imported legacy players have none.

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '1d', 0), count(*) as signups from audit_log where action = 'auth.signup' and $__timeFilter(ts) group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: Players by accounts on their plan
panels.description: Accounts that count toward max_bots: an event twin whose main exists rides on its main's slot and isn't counted.

targets.rawSql: with counted as ( select a.id, a.owner_id, a.created_at from game_accounts a where not (a.external_event and exists ( select 1 from game_accounts m where m.owner_id = a.owner_id and m.server_id = a.server_id and lower(m.name) = lower(a.name) and not m.external_event))) select n::text as accounts, count(*) as players from (select u.id, count(c.id) as n from users u left join counted c on c.owner_id = u.id where u.role = 'user' group by u.id) per_player group by n order by n

panels.title: Players who deleted their account, per day

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '1d', 0), count(*) as deletions from audit_log where action = 'account.deleted' and $__timeFilter(ts) group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: Accounts outside their owner's plan
panels.description: The plan rule (entitledAccountIds in @gge/contracts) in SQL: a player's oldest max_bots counted accounts by (created_at, id) may run, with their event twins; admins run all. Rows here can't run; one that is wanted running was left by a lowered limit or a demotion, and the runner refuses it.

targets.rawSql: with counted as ( select a.id, a.owner_id, a.created_at from game_accounts a where not (a.external_event and exists ( select 1 from game_accounts m where m.owner_id = a.owner_id and m.server_id = a.server_id and lower(m.name) = lower(a.name) and not m.external_event))), slots as (select id, row_number() over (partition by owner_id order by created_at, id) as slot from counted), placed as ( select a.id, a.owner_id, a.name, a.server_id, a.external_event, a.desired_state, coalesce(s.slot, (select ms.slot from game_accounts m join slots ms on ms.id = m.id where m.owner_id = a.owner_id and m.server_id = a.server_id and lower(m.name) = lower(a.name) and not m.external_event)) as slot from game_accounts a left join slots s on s.id = a.id) select u.username as owner, u.max_bots as plan, p.name as account, sv.label as server, p.external_event as "event twin", p.slot as "position by age", p.desired_state as wanted, st.actual_state as state from placed p join users u on u.id = p.owner_id join servers sv on sv.id = p.server_id left join bot_status st on st.account_id = p.id where u.role = 'user' and p.slot > greatest(u.max_bots, 0) order by u.username, p.slot, p.external_event
